course_name_original: Fundamentals of Automation and Control Engineering
course_name_en: Fundamentals of Automation and Control Engineering
prerequisites: MS-A010* Differential and integral calculus I and ELEC-A3110 Mechanics
Equivalent skills in math and physics

learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the most important application areas of automation and has a general overview of the field.
Understands the significance of measurements, actuators and feedback as part of the system.
Is able to build a simple system model from differential equations and simulate it.
Understands the basics of model calibration and learning a model from data.
Knows the basics of the PID controller.
Understands how automation and control technology is used to control robots and industrial processes.
Understands the basics of robot kinematics, dynamics, and control.

syllabus_topics: Optimization / calibration of a known model
Understanding higher-dimensional systems, such as robots, robot kinematics, dynamics, and control
